message.Title: Public Preview: Online and offline migrations in Azure DocumentDB Migration extension

Body.Content:
You can now migrate MongoDB workloads to Azure DocumentDB using the new Azure DocumentDB Migration extension for Visual Studio Code—now available in public preview. This seamless, zero-cost migration supports both online and offline modes, simplifying and accelerating your modernization journey. 

 

The migration jobs run entirely on Azure–managed resources, maintained by the Azure Cosmos DB team, so you don’t need to install or manage any infrastructure. You can initiate and monitor migrations without staying connected throughout the process, making it ideal for secure and large-scale scenarios. The extension also supports private endpoint-enabled targets, ensuring enterprise-grade security and compliance. 

 

Whether you're migrating from self-hosted MongoDB, MongoDB Atlas, or other compatible sources, this extension provides a unified, intuitive experience directly within Visual Studio Code. You benefit from improved performance, reduced operational overhead, and a streamlined path to Azure DocumentDB—all without incurring additional migration costs. 

Learn more.
